name: Convergent CRDT Replicated Store
description: Repair vector-clock max merge, idempotent counter merge, OR-Set add-wins tombstoning, LWW (ts,node) deterministic tiebreak, typed merge dispatch, and per-key peer convergence.
planted_defect: vector clock merge uses elementwise min, losing causality
GCounter merge sums counts so re-merge inflates the value
ORSet remove tombstones the element name, blocking concurrent re-adds
LWW compares timestamps only, diverging on equal-ts writes
merge_peer overwrites shared keys with peer state instead of merging
